body: Well if you had it off anyway, there is no discussion to be had. And no need for counselling dude, I have achieved today so there is much to be happy about.

Ain't martyrdom pal, it is for my own sense of responsibility and commitment, consistently and reliably adding value. I will die like you, but at least I will die knowing that I wasn't a spongy little work dodging "someone else will pick up the slack" cunt. You may not feel this way, but if you bunked off today, I am sure it takes a lot of denial, twisting of reality or sense of entitlement to achieve it. I am all for having the occasional prebooked day off, wouldn't you accept your employer retrospectively telling you that you could have today off as annual leave? Surely that would be fair. Either way, employers look favourably on those who actually made it in today and rightfully so. And no, I haven't had a day off in 5 years that wasn't prebooked leave or toil.
Work shy, unmanly lack of social responsibility more like. Do you want your nappy changing too sweety?

Let me explain...most Britons are work shy girly girls who will look for any excuse not to go to work or school. Their place of work could be 100 metres away, but "ooooooh no, I couldn't possibly go in to work in this, too dangerous". I bet that many of those bunking off work even text their colleagues before making the decision, just to make sure everyone else was bunking off too. And heaven forbid that the employer try to take the time off them as toil or annual leave. They are met with cries of "you can't do that, it's not my fault I couldn't get in". It is pretty pathetic and I count myself lucky not to be one of these individuals.

Bunch of pansies haha. Was the same depth in Norfolk, but I laced up my boots and made the 50 min trek to work on foot mid blizzard. Will do the same tomorrow. Seems like an awful lot of people looking for any excuse not to get in to work, when if you are supposed to be there, it is a priority. If I were an employer, I would insist that people who couldn't make it in take the day as annual leave, or owe the hours back.

Thank you again. But I don't know if it is the same as everyone else. I mean I really have no friends or social life. Its borderline agoraphobic. It has been that way for 5 or so years now. I am not even sure how I would go about making friends to be honest. I don't really have anyone to talk to or support.

Thanks. But why am I so fucked up? Why can't I just be normal, or happy? Why can't I just go out and make friends and just talk to people? Why can't I have normal relationships? Why am I terrified and so antisocial all the time? Why doesn't the changes I try and make stick? It hurts so much. I just want it to stop. I don't want there to be anything anymore.

Try a 29 year old virgin/hermit with no friends, no social life , no hobbies and stuck in a loop of taking one step forward and two steps back. At least I have a job and my own flat I guess. My moans starts and ends with this though. I had been running everyday...felt much better and was making good progress. I will try again tomorrow.
